text: Joann Smith is a wife, mother, educator, community leader, and advocate who has devoted nearly 30 years to serving students, families, and communities with compassion and integrity. A proud United States Army Veteran, her commitment to service and leadership has guided her lifelong work to strengthen educational opportunities and improve lives.

Joann earned a Bachelor of Arts in Psychology from Long Island University and a Masters of Education from Pepperdine University. She has taught in New York City and California, where she has served students and families while building strong relationships within the communities she serves.

Throughout her career, Joann has been a champion for educational excellence, equity, and student success. She has served as the Teacher Union Representative, chaired the Human Rights Committee for the High Desert Service Center Council (CTA), and mentored aspiring educators through the BETR Program (The Boundless Educator Teacher Residency). Over the years, she has volunteered extensively throughout her community in support of students, families, and local organizations.

Believing strongly in supporting the whole child, Joann is committed to helping every student learn and grow while serving as an advocate for students and a collaborative leader for the Palmdale School District and our community.

text: As a proud graduate of the Palmdale School District, where I attended school from kindergarten through eighth grade, I understand the lasting impact our schools have on students, families, and our community. The education and support I received here inspired my commitment to public service and my desire to give back by serving on the School Board. I currently work for the Los Angeles Superior Court. I believe the importance of strong schools, dedicated educators, and supportive communities in helping young people succeed. This experience has strengthened my commitment to making thoughtful, student-centered decisions.

I am also preparing to attend law school to further my ability to serve the public and advocate for children, families, and our community. As your School Board member, I will prioritize student achievement, safe and welcoming schools, fiscal responsibility, transparency, and meaningful partnerships with parents, teachers, and the community. I believe every child deserves access to a high-quality education and opportunities to reach their full potential. As someone who grew up in this district, I am committed to helping ensure today's students have the same opportunities to succeed. I respectfully ask for your vote and the opportunity to serve our community.
